choice: Close the tested positive directional body-matching claim. Test whether fixed simultaneous spatial coverage produces a useful acquired body-associated state under a common extracellular P/F reference, compared with sequential histories and central-only history.
question: Under identical actual HC extracellular arrays and a fixed U/D challenge, do the previously observed noncentral-history benefits persist in the body-associated package, and can a static simultaneous U+D coverage history produce the same kind of useful state without the sequential schedule?

evidence.body_matching: No repeatable positive body interaction in both bodytime and actual post256 retention; ring5601 anti-match, ring5602 bodytime/post256 conflict. Separate histories also lack reproducible positive matching.
evidence.extracellular: Eight fixed-body P/F interactions positive for bodytime/post256 but negative for finalE; not comprehensive advantage or mediation proportion.
evidence.maintenance: 36/40 actual probes pass both64 windows; four failures all separate HC. Earlier separate formation failure is retained but not generalized to every future.
evidence.visual_PI: Viewed acquired_body.png across all12 actual256 states: ring left-side thickening under HU/HD, weak connection of left separate clusters, relative to HC. No new morphotype or all-animation claim.

invariants: Original greedy, g2 rule package, deletion-layout off, native/pump/admission/basal prices, command0 and finite clock384 horizon remain unchanged. No writer, training, new pump/reserve/recycling layer, rule or rate change. All original balances and failures retained.

protocol.stage_scope: Begin at four previously acquired actual128 states. This is developmental continuation/acquired body construction, not a new life0 formation or new seed experiment.
protocol.H_B: For native129..192 inject 0.5*U+0.5*D each step for each cargo separately; native193..256 inject center. U/D are the identical original fixed life0 maps rolled dy -4/+4, as before. Do not recompute from current rho or displace existing inventories.
protocol.exposure: H_B is fixed simultaneous coverage. It matches HU/HD per-step gross and per-grid cumulative added P/F over129..192, then shares the same64center inputs. Local pulse intensity and simultaneity differ; this is not an order-only intervention or proof that coverage is the unique cause. HC has the same gross but a different spatial cumulative map.
protocol.acquisition: Four new H_B histories of128 steps each from exact original128 parents; preserve full160/192/256. All twelve HU/HD/HC history legs reused read-only with actual acquisition costs. No replay of them.
protocol.common_PF: At256 use each parent's actual saved HC precursor and fuel arrays, copied together identically into each full B in HU/HD/H_B. HC is its own sham. Preserve B rho, intracellularE, physics/rule state, labels, world, RNG and cumulative records. Retain L256/post256 observer state; H_B registers it at actual256 before exchange. Probe state must be byte-identical in P/F across histories, not normalized to a target sum.
protocol.exchange_account: Use the existing exact exchange_pf path. Record removed/received arrays and net material/fuel energy for each recipient. Unlike the old reciprocal crossover, several histories receive the same reference packet: these are separate experimental worlds with an explicitly accounted external reservoir, NOT a closed paired exchange. Do not subtract the exchange from biological costs to manufacture a net win; no physical work price exists for it. Own HC sham has zero exchange. History costs remain from each actual history.
protocol.body_interpretation: The retained body package includes rho and intracellularE, so a common-PF contrast isolates the effect of that complete state under this intervention, not geometry alone, a learned writer or cost-free biological acquisition. No resetting E, material labels or accumulated accounts.
protocol.probes: Each HU/HD/H_B under common HC P/F is cloned to fixed U and D probes for128 steps257..384. Same original U/D future maps and physical schedule as existing HC futures; no new phase, end clock or shifted source distance.
protocol.references: Reuse the eight exact old HC/H_C U/D probes at unchanged protocol, including full source hashes and their actual windows/ledgers. HC starts via the same sham-copy path. Prove state/input/observer equivalence by pure assembly; do not rerun reference futures or fill absent fields. If equivalence fails, record the mismatch and stop dependent execution rather than silently change comparator.
protocol.count: 512 new history native +24 new probes*128=3584 science native;4 new history legs and24 new futures;8 old HC futures1024 native read-only. Report32 distinct probe paths in the combined comparison, not32 new simulations.
protocol.tags: Inherited founder/L128 stay truthful. L256 records actual body at256; real later births enter post256. Carry actual K and actor/rule survival once. Report both retained masses and their sums. Labels and future outcomes never enter live policy.

contrasts.primary: For every seed/shape and U/D direction report HU-HC, HD-HC and H_B-HC under the same HC PF packet, with probe bodytime and actual post256 retained mass at384 co-primary. Also report all HU-H_B and HD-H_B contrasts without choosing the more favorable order.
contrasts.body_guard: For a useful-body advantage in a given shape, both co-primary contrasts must be positive and finalM/finalE must not fall (1e-8 accounting tolerance; zero sensitivity) in both directions and both already-selected seeds. If a sign differs, report conditional effects. No pooled mean overrides a failed case. Not a held-out confirmation.
contrasts.fixed_coverage: If H_B gives the same guarded advantage over HC, fixed simultaneous coverage is sufficient to produce a useful state in these conditions. Do not infer exact equivalence to HU/HD, unique causation, or absence of all history dependence. HU/HD beating H_B would remain a schedule-dependent package effect, not automatically directional memory.
contrasts.PF_removal: For existing HU/HD own-PF probes versus their new common-HC-PF probes, quantify the declared external packet replacement effect at each fixed body/probe. Keep this separate from all-HC body contrasts. No natural mediation fraction or assumption of additive components.
contrasts.reporting: FinalM/E, deltaM/E from256, U, bodytime, actual post256/L256/founder/post128, births/deaths, real fees/heat/exports/unpaid requests, pre/post exchange inventories and complete costs from128. Display acquisition and probe costs separately. No composite or uptake-only victory.
contrasts.maintenance: Both predeclared probe64 windows require born-death>=-1e-8, deltaE>=-1e-8,minM>=32; report zero tolerance too. Preserve actual successes/failures and report H_B history windows separately. Finite384 is not steady state.
contrasts.scope: Two related previously selected seeds and two fixed shapes. Spatial cells, U/D repeated probes and state transfers are not independent replicates. No new morphology or learned method claim.

budget.checks: Only input-map construction gains a convex sum; old native and exchange interfaces are unchanged. Use pure-array finite-schedule/gross/per-grid-integral, restoration/exchange/sham and original HC compatibility checks. No repeated old native boundaries; the first real H_B call is scientific and retained. Freeze adapter/plan before native.
budget.control: Read current research.desired_state/started before job; pause/stop forbids launching. PI observed running/true. All previous leftovers sealed, independent authorization only.
budget.failure: Charge every attempted/returned/settled native and every runner attempt. Do not replay unknown calls. Same-job explicit recovery only from known completed state; preserve failure and amendments. No extra job, borrowed budget or timer. If required checks cannot fit or treatment changes, stop dependent calls and hand off the exact issue.
